value.rationale: The mixed dependence of a permutation’s diagonal contacts (fixed points) and its increasing patterns is a natural two-statistic question. All lengths and all finite sizes have a strict nonobvious sign, an exact rank-collision formula, a finite-n quantitative bound and a sharp fixed-k scale/constant. This supplies structurally interpretable dependence beyond marginal expectations, not a small arbitrary slice or finite computational curiosity; conditional stochastic dominance is not claimed.
